name: Radon Number / Diameter (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter admits a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite binary classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For the $n$-singleton class $\mathcal S_n$, Radon number is $n$, while diameter is $2$.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For the trivial class $\mathcal T_n=\{\emptyset,[n]\}$, diameter is $n$, while Radon number is $2$.
proof: The two canonical value calculations give unbounded gaps in the two directions.
proof_source: Database-owned value proofs for Radon Number and Diameter of Trivial Concepts and Singletons.
